title: Define shared network download, TLS, proxy, progress, and cache boundaries
description: AstrBot centralizes HTTP download, cert fallback, proxy/trust-env behavior, public IP lookup, dashboard zip download/cache, and temp image saving in utils/io.py and http_ssl.py. Rust currently has provider HTTP helpers and media normalization plans, but no shared network-file boundary for platform media downloads, provider attachments, dashboard updates, T2I network artifacts, or future plugin/package downloads.

files.change: Expose typed download, TLS, proxy, progress, and cache policies without coupling callers to reqwest/aio-like implementation details.
Represent GET/POST downloads, destination path policy, content type expectations, size limits, and temporary artifact output.
Keep certificate fallback, proxy/trust-env, and insecure fallback decisions explicit and testable.
Model progress snapshots for dashboard update/plugin/KB upload flows without printing from download helpers.

criteria: Provider, platform, render, and maintenance code can share download/TLS policy through traits or DTOs.
Progress and cache behavior are not embedded in dashboard route handlers.
Media normalization remains separate from generic network transfer.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-net && cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
